$ gremlins --version
gremlins version dev linux/arm64

$ go version -m /data/bin/gremlins
/data/bin/gremlins: go1.25.0
	path	github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/cmd/gremlins
	mod	github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins	v0.6.0	h1:3G2ROO0I3q4bb5bxElQIUITTuEbl1iOfVYFqunGwrJI=
	dep	github.com/MakeNowJust/heredoc	v1.0.0	h1:cXCdzVdstXyiTqTvfqk9SDHpKNjxuom+DOlyEeQ4pzQ=
	dep	github.com/bluekeyes/go-gitdiff	v0.8.1	h1:lL1GofKMywO17c0lgQmJYcKek5+s8X6tXVNOLxy4smI=
	dep	github.com/fatih/color	v1.18.0	h1:S8gINlzdQ840/4pfAwic/ZE0djQEH3wM94VfqLTZcOM=
	dep	github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify	v1.9.0	h1:2Ml+OJNzbYCTzsxtv8vKSFD9PbJjmhYF14k/jKC7S9k=
	dep	github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2	v2.4.0	h1:EBsztssimR/CONLSZZ04E8qAkxNYq4Qp9LvH92wZUgs=
  ...

The embedded build info is plain text inside the binary (`mod\t<path>\t<version>\th1:...`), so it can be read
without spawning go: a regexp over the file bytes for  (^|\n|\t)mod\t<path ending /gremlins>\t(v...)  gives v0.6.0.
A `dep` line (dep\tgithub.com/x/gremlins\t...) never counts, and a `(devel)` module version is no version.
